profile: Atara Biotherapeutics develops allogeneic T-cell immunotherapies for cancer and autoimmune diseases. Through a partnership with Pierre Fabre, it supports commercialization of Ebvallo in Europe and the United Kingdom for Epstein-Barr virus-positive post-transplant lymphoproliferative disease. In the United States, the FDA has accepted a resubmitted biologics license application for tab-cel, with a target action date in 2027.
